enGB: You train as though every task were a stone to be lifted, making strength the foundation of your whole bearing.
zhCN: 你将每一次试炼都视作待举之石，以力量奠定身心的根基。

enGB: Balance, breath, and movement flow together like quicksilver, carrying your discipline beyond the blade.
zhCN: 步法、呼吸与重心如水银般连贯，将敏捷的修习带到兵刃之外。

enGB: Years of hardship have taught your body to meet every ordeal with the patience of tempered metal.
zhCN: 多年的磨砺让你的身躯学会以百炼金属般的沉稳迎接试炼。

enGB: You study your own habits like an arcane diagram, turning careful understanding into practiced control.
zhCN: 你如研读奥术图谱般审视自身习惯，以理解换来娴熟的控制。

enGB: Following the ideal of self-perfection associated with Irori, you make quiet attention the center of your practice.
zhCN: 你借鉴伊洛里的自我完善之道，以宁静而专注的觉察统摄修习。

enGB: Your confidence gathers scattered effort into a single purpose, as a sovereign gathers a wavering court.
zhCN: 你的自信将纷乱的行动凝成一个目标，宛如君主整肃摇摆的王庭。

enGB: Rather than chase delicate openings, you commit your weight to a weapon's path and trust its momentum.
zhCN: 你不追逐细小的空隙，而将身量压入兵刃的轨迹，借其惯势出手。

enGB: Inspired by Aldori dueling traditions, you guide the blade with balance and exacting footwork.
zhCN: 你借鉴阿尔多里的决斗传统，以重心与精确步法驾驭剑锋。

enGB: A steady breath and a planted stance keep your weapon true even when fatigue begins to bite.
zhCN: 即使疲惫袭来，沉稳的呼吸与扎实的站姿仍让兵刃沿着预定轨迹前行。

enGB: You see the duel as intersecting lines, choosing each stroke by angle rather than impulse.
zhCN: 你将交锋视作交错的线条，依角度而非冲动选择每一次出手。

enGB: You watch the intention behind a motion and meet your opponent where their next step will lead.
zhCN: 你察看动作背后的意图，在对手下一步将至之处迎击。

enGB: A flourish invites the eye to follow one story while your weapon pursues another.
zhCN: 华丽的虚招引导敌人的目光，兵刃则沿另一条轨迹逼近。

enGB: Lightly burdened, you guard yourself through a traveler's quiet awareness and measured movement.
zhCN: 轻装行走时，你凭旅人的沉静觉察与适度挪移守护自身。

enGB: Anatomy turns a grapple into a study of joints, leverage, and the direction of resistance.
zhCN: 关节、杠杆与抵抗的方向，使每一次擒抱都成为对身体结构的实践。

enGB: You hold your ground with the bearing of someone who expects to be obeyed.
zhCN: 你以不容轻忽的威仪站稳阵地，令自己的坚持清晰可见。

enGB: Strong legs and a deliberate stance let you answer force without surrendering your footing.
zhCN: 强健的双腿与审慎的站姿，让你在抵抗外力时守住立足之处。

enGB: With little armor to hamper you, every small shift of weight becomes part of your guard.
zhCN: 少了重甲的牵制，每一次细微的重心转移都成为防守的一部分。

enGB: You have learned to carry hardship in your flesh as a forge carries the day's heat.
zhCN: 你学会如熔炉蓄热般承受艰辛，让磨砺沉淀于血肉之中。

enGB: You brace like a fortress buttress, letting practiced strength support your whole defense.
zhCN: 你如要塞的扶壁般支撑阵线，让娴熟的力量托住整个防御。

enGB: You borrow the rhythm of a swaying reed, keeping your guard in motion rather than fixing it in place.
zhCN: 你借芦苇摇曳的韵律不断调整守势，不将防守锁在一处。

enGB: Old scars remind you how to endure a blow and keep your composure under strain.
zhCN: 旧伤教会你承受冲击，也教会你在压力下保持镇定。

enGB: You read the angle of an approaching strike and place your guard where it will matter.
zhCN: 你读出来袭兵刃的角度，将防守放在真正需要的位置。

enGB: Patient attention catches small changes in a foe's bearing before they become a committed attack.
zhCN: 耐心的观察捕捉敌人姿态的细微变化，先于其决意出手作出准备。

enGB: Your unyielding bearing turns defense into a contest of resolve as much as steel.
zhCN: 你的坚定威仪使防守既是兵刃的较量，也是意志的交锋。

enGB: You bring the weight of a great beast to every grip, push, and struggle for position.
zhCN: 你将巨兽般的力量投入每一次抓握、推挤与位置争夺。

enGB: A small turn at the right pivot can redirect more force than a head-on struggle.
zhCN: 在恰当支点的一次轻转，往往比迎面角力更能改变力量的方向。

enGB: Endurance lets you maintain a hold after the first contest of strength has passed.
zhCN: 耐力让你在最初的力量较量之后，仍能维持稳固的控制。

enGB: You study how joints move together and use that knowledge to guide a maneuver.
zhCN: 你研究关节如何协同活动，并以这份知识引导战技。

enGB: You feel an opponent's balance through contact, answering their movement with your own.
zhCN: 你从接触中感知对手的重心，以自己的动作回应其变化。

enGB: An assertive step and a forceful challenge lend conviction to your attempt to unseat a foe.
zhCN: 果断的步伐与强势的挑战，让你动摇敌人站位的行动更有决心。

enGB: Work that tires others teaches you the discipline of applying strength with care.
zhCN: 让他人疲惫的劳作，教会你谨慎运用力量的技艺。

enGB: Your hands learn each task as a rhythm, returning to its fine motions with a performer's ease.
zhCN: 你的双手将工作记作节奏，细小动作也能如表演般自然重现。

enGB: Where inspiration fades, patient repetition keeps your craft moving forward.
zhCN: 灵感消退之处，耐心的反复练习仍推动你的技艺前行。

enGB: You connect unfamiliar problems to knowledge already gathered, building bridges between disciplines.
zhCN: 你将陌生问题与已有知识相连，在不同学问之间架起桥梁。

enGB: Travel and observation have taught you to hear what a task requires before reaching for a tool.
zhCN: 行旅与观察教会你先听懂事情的需要，再伸手取用工具。

enGB: Confidence carries your performance through unfamiliar work, inviting others to believe in your command.
zhCN: 自信让你在陌生事务中仍保持从容，也让旁人愿意相信你的掌握。

enGB: You approach an incantation as a smith approaches iron, shaping it with disciplined exertion.
zhCN: 你如铁匠对待生铁般对待咒语，以严整的发力塑成法术。

enGB: Exact, practiced gestures give your spellwork the cadence of a deft duelist.
zhCN: 精准而娴熟的手势，使你的施法带上灵巧剑客的节奏。

enGB: You make bodily endurance part of your magical practice, learning to bear the effort of channeling power.
zhCN: 你将身体的耐力纳入魔法修习，学会承受引导力量的消耗。

enGB: Every spell becomes a proposition to study, refine, and set beside the work of earlier arcanists.
zhCN: 每一道法术都是可研读与改进的命题，与前人的奥术成果相互印证。

enGB: You listen for the cadence beneath an incantation and let attentive instinct guide its expression.
zhCN: 你聆听咒语深处的节律，以专注的直觉引导它的表达。

enGB: You speak an incantation with the confidence of a decree, giving its form the weight of conviction.
zhCN: 你以宣告法旨般的自信吟诵咒语，让信念为法术的形式添上分量。

enGB: You commit to the next blow with a battle zeal reminiscent of Gorum, leaving less attention for your guard.
zhCN: 你以令人想起戈鲁姆的战意全力挥击，也因此分出更少心力守护自身。

enGB: Like a willow in a gale, you favor yielding movement over the force of a committed strike.
zhCN: 你如狂风中的柳枝般顺势而动，将余力留给闪避而非重击。

enGB: You settle into a mountain's patient stillness, gathering yourself at the cost of offensive tempo.
zhCN: 你如山岳般沉稳地收束自身，并为此放慢进攻的节奏。

enGB: You study the openings left by passing foes, keeping a careful account of their movement.
zhCN: 你研读敌人移动时留下的空隙，审慎把握他们的行动轨迹。

enGB: You quiet the impulse to strike, accepting a gentler attack in exchange for a steadier guard.
zhCN: 你平息急于出手的冲动，以较轻的攻势换取更稳固的守势。

enGB: You place your companions' courage before your own safety and become the standard they rally around.
zhCN: 你将同伴的勇气置于自身安危之前，成为众人聚拢的旗帜。

enGB: When injury narrows your choices, you answer with the stubborn patience of a cornered animal.
zhCN: 伤势使选择愈发有限时，你以困兽般的坚忍回应危局。

enGB: You practice the opening exchange until the first heartbeat of a fight feels familiar.
zhCN: 你反复磨炼交锋的起手，让战斗最初的一瞬也有迹可循。

enGB: A companion's death gives grief a direction, lending fierce purpose to the strokes that follow.
zhCN: 同伴的阵亡为悲痛赋予方向，让接下来的挥击承载复仇的决心。

enGB: You reserve your fullest commitment for the first clean opportunity of each exchange.
zhCN: 你将最充足的心力留给每一次交锋中最先到来的出手机会。

enGB: At the edge of defeat, you trade caution for a final display of the Iron Lord's battle fervor.
zhCN: 败亡临近时，你放下谨慎，以铁甲之神般的战斗热忱作最后一搏。

enGB: One exchange gives you a pattern to study, letting later attacks follow a better-informed line.
zhCN: 一次交锋便为你提供可研读的线索，让之后的攻击沿着更明晰的轨迹展开。

enGB: Years of spellwork teach you to turn practiced magical control toward personal defense.
zhCN: 多年的施法修习，让你学会将娴熟的魔力控制用于自身防守。

enGB: Battle has trained your responses until endurance, movement, and resolve share the same rhythm.
zhCN: 战斗锤炼你的反应，使耐力、行动与意志有了共同的节律。

enGB: Lessons gathered from many crafts become practical answers to an enemy's approach.
zhCN: 从各门技艺中积累的经验，成为你应对敌人来势的实际手段。

enGB: You make the discipline of channeling magic part of the discipline of sustaining yourself.
zhCN: 你将引导魔法的修习融入维持自身生机的修习。

enGB: When battle begins, your practiced spellwork gathers around you like a brief mantle of dawn.
zhCN: 战斗开始时，娴熟的施法力量如短暂的晨辉般聚拢在你周围。

enGB: The precision learned with a weapon gives you another way to shape demanding magic.
zhCN: 从兵刃上学来的精准，为你驾驭复杂魔法提供另一条途径。

enGB: You lend your summoned companions the forceful bearing that guides your own movements.
zhCN: 你将支配自身行动的强劲力量借给召来的伙伴。

enGB: The rhythm of your agile steps becomes a pattern for the creatures answering your call.
zhCN: 你灵巧步伐的节奏，成为回应召唤的生物可以追随的范式。

enGB: You draw on your own hardiness when preparing a body for a summoned companion.
zhCN: 为召来的伙伴塑成躯体时，你借鉴自身承受磨砺的耐力。

enGB: You plan a summoned creature's defenses as carefully as an architect plans a wall.
zhCN: 你如建筑师设计城墙般，仔细安排召唤生物的防守。

enGB: Attentive guidance helps a summoned companion meet danger with steadier instincts.
zhCN: 专注的引导帮助召来的伙伴，以更稳固的本能迎接危险。

enGB: Your confident command gives summoned companions a clear purpose when they enter the fray.
zhCN: 自信的指挥让召来的伙伴在投入战斗时拥有明确目标。

enGB: You accept a body's burden so that the creatures bound to your call may stand stronger.
zhCN: 你甘愿让自身承受负担，使回应你召唤的生物更加强健。

enGB: An exacting pact magnifies what you surrender, letting sacrifice feed a companion's strength.
zhCN: 严密的契约放大你付出的代价，让牺牲转为伙伴的力量。

enGB: You yield some commanding presence to give a summoned body greater physical force.
zhCN: 你让渡部分统御的气势，为召来的躯体换取更强的筋骨之力。

enGB: You train to deliver a committed blow in the cramped space inside an opponent's guard.
zhCN: 你磨炼在逼近敌人守势的狭窄空间内全力出手的技巧。

enGB: Distance gives you room to read a target's line and settle the weapon before release.
zhCN: 距离为你留出判断目标轨迹的余地，也让兵刃在出手前更加稳定。

enGB: You study the middle ground of an engagement, where spacing lets a weapon do its best work.
zhCN: 你研究交锋的中间距离，让恰当间隔帮助兵刃发挥所长。

enGB: You approach abjuration with patient attention, choosing its wards over other branches of magic.
zhCN: 你以耐心而专注的觉察修习防护术，并将它的结界置于其他魔法之前。

enGB: Your magic finds its clearest voice at the threshold between a call and an answer.
zhCN: 你的魔法在呼唤与回应的门槛之间，找到最清晰的表达。

enGB: You compare signs and patterns until divination feels like reading a carefully kept record.
zhCN: 你反复比对征兆与规律，让预言术如阅读详尽的记录般有章可循。

enGB: You study how conviction and desire give enchantment a foothold in another mind.
zhCN: 你研究信念与欲望如何为惑控术提供触及他人心智的立足点。

enGB: You favor the direct expression of energy, shaping evocation with an architect's deliberate design.
zhCN: 你偏爱能量的直接表达，以建筑师般的审慎规划塑成塑能术。

enGB: Light, expectation, and careful presentation become the instruments of your illusion craft.
zhCN: 光影、期待与精心安排的呈现，成为你编织幻术的工具。

enGB: You study mortality's thresholds; the Boneyard is an image for that inquiry, not a claim of Pharasma's approval.
zhCN: 你研习死生的界限；骨园只是这份探究的意象，并不代表获得法拉斯玛的认可。

enGB: You consider every material form a structure whose relationships can be understood and rearranged.
zhCN: 你将物质的形态视作可被理解与重新安排的结构关系。

enGB: You give fire magic the fierce expression of your own conviction, borrowing the phoenix as its image.
zhCN: 你让火焰魔法承载自身热烈的信念，借凤凰作为它的意象。

enGB: Still attention lends your cold magic the patient character of a glacier.
zhCN: 沉静的专注赋予寒冷魔法如冰川般耐心而坚定的气质。

enGB: Your practiced gestures trace the paths by which lightning takes shape.
zhCN: 娴熟的手势描出雷电逐渐成形的路径。

enGB: You bring an alchemist's attention to acid magic, considering how each surface yields to corrosion.
zhCN: 你以炼金术师般的专注修习强酸魔法，思量不同表面如何承受腐蚀。

enGB: You shape sonic magic with the same conviction that carries your voice across a hall.
zhCN: 你以让声音响彻厅堂的同一种信念，塑成音波魔法。

enGB: You picture invisible force as an exact arrangement of pressures and boundaries.
zhCN: 你将无形的力场想象为压力与边界的精确排列。

enGB: The image of first light gives your positive-energy magic a clear and generous expression.
zhCN: 初升晨光的意象，让正能量魔法有了明晰而慷慨的表达。

enGB: You contemplate endings until negative-energy magic finds a restrained, deliberate form.
zhCN: 你静思万物的终结，使负能量魔法呈现克制而审慎的形式。

enGB: You study the threads of attention through which mind-affecting magic takes hold.
zhCN: 你研究影响心灵的魔法如何沿注意力的细线取得立足点。

enGB: You imagine armor as a thorned carapace, turning the idea of a close assault back upon its source.
zhCN: 你将护甲想象为带刺的甲壳，让贴身攻击的意象反向指向来袭之处。

enGB: Layered armor becomes the image of a portable fortress, built to endure one exchange at a time.
zhCN: 层叠甲胄化作移动要塞的意象，准备承受一次又一次交锋。

enGB: You commit to a wider arc of engagement, accepting a less forceful blow as the price of distance.
zhCN: 你将战线推向更宽的弧面，并接受出手力道减弱作为距离的代价。

enGB: Choose one feat. Each choice grants only the selected feat. You can return to this selection whenever you gain another feat; each feat's normal prerequisites and mutual-exclusion rules still apply.
zhCN: 选择一项专长。每次选择只获得最终选中的专长。以后每获得一次专长选择机会，都可以再次进入此菜单；各专长的通常先决条件和互斥规则仍然适用。

enGB: Choose a source attribute, then the one ability score it improves. A character can normally have only one Main Attribute Mastery feat.
zhCN: 先选择来源属性，再选择它提升的一项属性。通常每个角色只能拥有一个主属性专精专长。

enGB: Choose a weapon category in which you are proficient. Replace mode (default): Use your Strength modifier instead of the weapon's existing damage attribute when this improves damage. The normal weapon damage multiplier is preserved, including two-handed and off-hand use. Add mode: Add your positive Strength modifier once to normal weapon damage. This extra bonus is not multiplied or halved for two-handed or off-hand use. Only applies to attacks with the chosen category that already use an attribute modifier for damage. Weapons without a damage attribute (such as ordinary crossbows) gain no benefit. Does not change attack rolls, spell damage, or other statistics. Does not require Power Mode. You can take this feat again for a different weapon category. When mutual exclusivity is enabled, you can select only one attribute within this family. Choose the active mode in the Weapon Damage setting. Changes apply on the next damage calculation, without restarting or reselecting the feat.
zhCN: 选择一种你已擅长的武器类别。 替代模式（Replace，默认）：如果能提高伤害，就用你的力量调整值替代武器原有的伤害属性调整值。保留武器通常的伤害属性倍率，包括双手持握和副手攻击的倍率。 叠加模式（Add）：在正常武器伤害上额外加上一次你的正力量调整值。这项额外加值不会因双手持握而提高，也不会因副手攻击而减半。 仅对所选类别中原本就使用属性调整值计算伤害的武器攻击生效。不使用伤害属性的武器（例如普通弩）无法受益。不改变攻击检定、法术伤害或其他数值。无需开启强力模式（Power Mode）。 你可以再次选择本专长，以应用于不同的武器类别。启用互斥时，同系列只能选择一种属性。在 Weapon Damage 设置中选择生效模式；改动从下一次伤害计算起生效，无需重启或重新选择专长。
